server_policy: inference-only; shared model and node installation requires worker owner approval

audio_strategy.default_contract: Synchronized ambience and Foley with visual-prompt speech stripped and speech/gibberish negatives
audio_strategy.native_dialogue: Short, single-speaker, exact quoted lines only
audio_strategy.reliable_long_form: Generate visuals silently, then mix an uploaded voiceover during local export

modes.name: Visual Bible (Ingredients)
modes.purpose: Carry recurring character, prop, product, logo, and location identity from a composite reference sheet into a shot.
limitations: Requires a reference sheet supplied as a static video of at least 121 frames.
Other resolutions and substantially longer clips are outside the documented training bucket.

modes.name: Video Inpainting & Outpainting
modes.purpose: Remove or replace masked subjects and objects, or extend the canvas beyond the source frame while preserving surrounding motion.

recommended.frames: 8n+1, up to 121 on the current route

limitations: A static mask must match the source pixel dimensions; an animated mask must also match its frame count.
Describe only the generated masked or outpainted region. Include shadows, reflections, and contact areas in removal masks.
The 24 GB route is limited to 121 frames and a 1024-pixel delivery edge per pass.

modes.name: Creative Spatial Upscaler
modes.purpose: Re-render an approved low-resolution clip at 2x or 4x resolution with synthesized LTX detail.
limitations: This is a generative upscaler, not a pixel-faithful refiner.
It is an explicit post-process and never replaces the stable generation graph.
The 24 GB worker route is capped to a 1536-pixel long edge and 121 frames per pass.

modes.name: Water Simulation
modes.purpose: Add reference-conditioned water behavior and fluid effects to an existing shot.

recommended.frames: 8n+1, up to 121 on the current route

limitations: Requires a dry 24 fps source clip and a concrete description of water motion and interaction.
Runs stage one only; source audio is discarded because it cannot contain the newly added water sounds. Apply Foley V2A afterward for a matched soundtrack.

modes.name: Video Deblur
modes.purpose: Regenerate an out-of-focus clip with sharper detail while retaining subject, framing, motion, and scene geometry.
limitations: It targets defocus blur; compression damage and low source resolution require different tools.

modes.name: Video Decompression
modes.purpose: Remove macroblocking, ringing, chroma bleed, and banding from heavily compressed video.
limitations: It does not replace deblur, denoise, or spatial upscaling and should remain a stage-one identity-preserving edit.

modes.name: Cross-Eyed Character Effect
modes.purpose: Apply the collection's deliberately cross-eyed facial-performance effect for stylized or comedic shots.
limitations: The active Studio route is reference-video-to-video and works best on a close-up portrait with straight eyes.
Use only when the operator explicitly wants this character effect; it is never part of normal generation.

modes.name: Instant Shave
modes.purpose: Remove beard, mustache, and stubble while preserving identity, expression, lighting, motion, and the surrounding scene.
limitations: Designed for facial-hair removal, not general face replacement or beauty retouching.
25 fps is the recommended training bucket; the current route accepts clips up to 121 frames.

modes.name: Video Colorization
modes.purpose: Colorize monochrome footage with prompt-directed hues while preserving the source composition and motion.
limitations: High-resolution sources may need preparation near the documented training bucket to avoid weak color or bleeding.

modes.name: Day to Night
modes.purpose: Relight a daytime shot into a coherent night scene while retaining composition, camera movement, and subject motion.
limitations: Prompts must describe the desired night lighting rather than changing scene content.

modes.name: Cinemagraph
modes.purpose: Turn a still image into a restrained looping shot where selected details move and the rest of the composition stays stable.
limitations: Designed for a locked-off camera and exactly described selective motion; people and the rest of the composition should remain frozen.
The source image is center-cropped to the nearest documented training orientation and the delivered 25-frame clip is structurally silent.

modes.name: Foley Video-to-Audio
modes.purpose: Generate synchronized environmental sound and Foley for an approved silent or weak-audio clip.
limitations: The current 24 GB route accepts up to 121 frames per pass.
Foley is non-speech and non-music; it replaces the source soundtrack while preserving source video frames.

modes.name: Clean Plate
modes.purpose: Remove people or unwanted foreground objects and reconstruct the empty background plate across time.
limitations: The prompt should describe the desired empty scene; difficult occluders also need explicit negative constraints.

companion_modes.name: LipDub Speech Replacement
companion_modes.input_kind: one-speaker source video with speech + exact dialogue text
companion_modes.purpose: Dub or rephrase one visible speaker by regenerating lip motion and audio for exact operator-authored dialogue while retaining speaker identity from the source voice.
limitations: This is an LTX 2.3 companion model, not one of the current Creative Lab collection entries.
Use one visible speaker and a source clip that contains that speaker's voice; the source audio supplies identity reference tokens.
Enter the final desired words in the target language's native script; the model does not translate automatically.
For the best audio, keep the replacement line close to the timing and length of the original speech.
